title: A Brand New Fluffball
text: Big Sister had indeed transformed into her beast form on several occasions. The first time was during one of my loops, when she changed on her own initiative. Aside from that, there was the time when the Raph-species was created and someone intervened during her Class Up. In the loop where I was reunited with Fleon-chan, Big Sister had turned into a Raph-species beastwoman. It seemed Rafumi had heard about that particular story from Rival.

“This one’s genetic factors are unstable, but with my power—which, despite a few differences, is well-versed in the magical science of the future—it’ll be simple enough. I hear the original had tremendous resistance to transforming into a beastman, but it proved effective on the Shield Hero.”
Rafumi grabbed Rabbit Guy by the arm and started walking off without further ado.
“We’re heading to the Dragon Hourglass! I shall bloom your dormant factor as a way to pass the time. Become the mightiest fluffball there is.”

“W-wait! Whoa! This person’s not as strong as the Spear Hero, but still really strong! Ugh… please don’t put illusions on me, my head’s spinning! S-somebody help! I’m going to be turned into some kind of modified human or mysterious creature! Iwatani-samaaaa! Help meeeee!”
“So noisy! Spear Hero, shut it up already, or I’ll make sure Filo never enters your field of vision again.”
“Guh!?”

What kind of nerve did it have, threatening me like that!? Still, being kept from ever seeing Filo-tan was a fate I simply could not accept. So, most reluctantly, I paralyzed Rabbit Guy with my Paralyze Lance.
“Help—guh—!”

And so Rafumi and I dragged Rabbit Guy off to the Dragon Hourglass. I wasn’t sure where Rafumi had even found the thing, but there it stood, deep in the mountains far from any human settlement, and there she performed Rabbit Guy’s Class Up.

Rafumi laid the paralyzed Rabbit Guy beside the Dragon Hourglass like some sort of sacrificial offering, performed the Class Up, and had my spear react to it. With a puff, Rabbit Guy’s Class Up seemed to be complete.
“Cough! Cough!”

The moment Rafumi finished the Class Up, she immediately treated the paralysis, and Rabbit Guy started waving his hands frantically, coughing up puffs of smoke. Then he began cautiously checking his own ears, body, and tail.
“I haven’t been turned into one of those Raph-species things, have I? My ears are fine, right?”
“No problems whatsoever, I say.”
“Honestly! What do you think you’re doing, forcing this on me!”
“I merely granted your wish, did I not? Now… you may thank me for my brilliance!”

Hmph! Rafumi puffed out her chest proudly. But I already knew full well just how much of a scatterbrain she really was. It would come as no surprise at all if Rabbit Guy turned out a tanuki-man instead of a bunny. …Speaking of tanuki, there was a certain piece of pottery that came to mind.
“Say, Rabbit Guy, is your groin all right? It might swell up rather impressively, you know.”
What do you mean by that!? protested the Big Sister in my memories, but this was a necessary confirmation, I say.
“I-it hasn’t gotten any bigger.”
“You must remain vigilant. It may swell after some time has passed, after all.”
“Enough insulting me. If you wish for it that badly, Spear Hero… shall I cast a permanent illusion making your own groin appear enormous? I think it would suit you perfectly, don’t you?”
What kind of proposal was that!?
“I don’t want that at all, I say!”
No matter how you looked at it, being too big was simply unwelcome. Ugh… that Rafumi! What a troublesome creature she was, through and through.
“Just check yourself already. According to my analysis, this should have stabilized your genetic ailment. I’ve even elevated it to a stable state for your descendants as well, you know?”
“Even so…”

“What, are you telling me you don’t even know how to transform into your beast form? Well, that particular field happens to fall outside my jurisdiction, but I imagine anyone versed in beastification could tell you right away.”
Rabbit Guy examined his own body over and over, meticulously. Since he was Father’s slave, it was a shame we couldn’t check his status clearly.
“As for the beast transformation itself, my body just seems to change on its own, so I do have some sense of it, but…”
“Then look properly. There shouldn’t be any pain, nor any strange side effects to the beastification, understand?”
“…It sounds rather suspicious, but I suppose I’ll try.”
Looking thoroughly unconvinced, Rabbit Guy let out a sigh and clenched his fist.
“Hmph!”
Fur began sprouting and swelling out from Rabbit Guy’s body. The transformation happened fairly quickly, and it seemed complete before long.

Rabbit Guy appeared to have fully transformed into a large-bodied rabbit beastman. The form suited the description “rabbit beastman” perfectly. Somewhere in my memory, the image of a large rabbit beastman I’d once seen riding aboard a ship surfaced. Where had I met him again? I couldn’t quite recall, but this rabbit form gave off an impression like they might have been siblings.
“Um, have I… changed shape? I still can’t quite believe it.”
Rabbit Guy looked at both his hands, then touched his fluffy paws to his face, then checked his back, tail, and legs in turn.
“Indeed. The Class Up was a success. Well? You may thank me now.”

Hmm… so this was the form Rabbit Guy took when beastified. But I doubted it came anywhere close to matching my own fluffiness and cuteness back when I’d been an usaunny! When it came to rabbit-cuteness, I simply could not afford to lose! In the back of my mind, I felt as though Father—both from the original world and the one where I was reunited with Fleon-chan—were saying, What on earth are you competing over? But that was surely just my imagination.
“There’s nothing weird about it, right? No forgotten details from the transformation or anything? Since it happened without any pain, and I’ve never changed this much before, I’m a little anxious…”
“There’s nothing forgotten anywhere. What a suspicious fellow you are. Isn’t that right, Spear Hero?”
“Indeed, I say.”
“Now then! Go run wild in that form, as far as you please! The wilderness awaits you!”
“If I get carried away and run off like that, I won’t end up like old Wolf did, getting completely consumed by instinct and forgetting everything, or being unable to change back, will I?”
Rabbit Guy shot Rafumi a look of deep suspicion.

“Whatever story are you pulling that from? You seem to have read entirely too many fantastical tales, but don’t you dare lump me in with some incompetent researcher of that caliber. Do you know who created me? Azott, that’s who!”
“Isn’t that the one who’s currently in an Inult body getting harassed by Luna-san!?”
“Ugh, what an infuriatingly talkative pest you are! That person was involved in my version upgrade. There’s no room for a mistake of that magnitude!”
Rafumi declared this with total conviction. Well, admittedly, Rabbit Guy was about as persistent as Itsuki when he got going.
“A-anyway, let me change back…”
With a pop, Rabbit Guy reverted to his Demi-Human form.
“I—I’m back to normal. Still, when I transform, my line of sight rises quite a bit… so that’s what beastification feels like. My strength seemed to surge too… I’m not entirely sure.”

Originally, when Rabbit Guy’s arm had changed into a beastman’s arm, it had already grown noticeably larger. It stood to reason that when the whole body transformed, the overall frame would grow larger too. Keel, on the other hand, went the opposite direction, shrinking down. I also shrank when I turned into an usaunny. …Thinking about it, small was cute in its own right, but perhaps there was also merit in the method of becoming a big usaunny. Father had been quite fond of the oversized Raph-species too! Big Usaunnies deserved further research, I say!
“Well? I granted your wish, didn’t I? Feel free to thank me as much as you like.”
“I’m extremely unhappy with the method, though… you went and performed the Class Up on me without permission and everything.”
Incidentally, she’d first reset his level before raising it again and performing the Class Up a second time.
“Say whatever you like. Results are all that matter in the end. Now, go on and shamelessly flatter the Shield Hero, and let him enjoy your fluffiness to his heart’s content.”
“Could you maybe phrase that differently? I mean… I wanted my awakening to come through some dramatic event, like the ones Shion or Wolf had.”
“You awakened through an episode showcasing my own brilliance. Isn’t that good enough? Being dissatisfied with that is nothing but selfishness.”
If anything, I thought this was much the same category of event as Big Sister’s own Raph-species transformation.
“Haah… don’t I get some kind of dramatic backstory or fated bond, like Shion or Wolf had…? Maybe I’ve just gotten too caught up dreaming about stories like that.”

Rabbit Guy really did seem to harbor quite the inferiority complex. This was probably exactly the sort of thing that made him remind me of Itsuki. Well, he had spent a long time living as a slave, after all.

“Hmph. Foolish. Are you saying that without some tragic past, you can’t stand as an equal among your fellow slaves? If you’re going to lose simply because you lack that as one of the Hero’s subordinates, then your resolve is far too flimsy.”
Rabbit Guy looked visibly annoyed at Rafumi’s remark. That was supposed to be my line!
“Calling yourself Father’s loyal subordinate over something so trivial is laughable, I say.”
No matter how many times I looped through time, I had resolved to fight for Father and Filo-tan’s sake, without fail.
“At this rate, it doesn’t seem like you’ll be building up the sort of debt that lets you serve as Father’s subordinate again in the next loop.”

“I have no intention of backing down over something like this! I understand. Fine, then. Even if my past pales in comparison to those two, I won’t lose when it comes to loyalty! Yes! I shall let Iwatani-sama savor and be healed by the full charm of my fluffiness to his heart’s content!”
With a puff, Rabbit Guy transformed into his beast form and fluffed out his fur to show it off. Hmph! As if that could ever surpass the enchanting touch of Filolial-sama’s fur!
“Now then, charge forth to the Shield Hero!”
“Right! Let’s show him this brand-new fluffball!”
And with that, in some fashion or another, we made our way back toward Father.
